claims.text: The source defines Pick-a-Pic: web-app two-image pairwise choice plus tie (backbones SD2.1/Dreamlike/SDXL, varied guidance); 583,747 training examples / 37,523 prompts / 4,375 users with prompt-disjoint splits; PickScore is CLIP-H fine-tuned 4000 steps with InstructGPT-style KL preference objective plus inverse-prompt-frequency weighting.

Reported numbers: preference accuracy PickScore 70.5% vs experts 68.0%, CLIP-H 60.8%, random 56.8%; MS-COCO win-rate correlation 0.917 vs FID −0.900; Elo correlation 0.790±0.054 vs HPS 0.670; ranking win rates 71.3-85.1%.

limitations.text: Self-selected social-media users; NSFW residue; 'superhuman' is vs context-blind annotators, not vs originating users.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Generalisation beyond tested backbones/guidance scales not established.
